title: Bachata
style: reggaeton, salsa, bachata, latin pop, cumbia
lyrics:
[Verse]
Ay Love bachata under the moon's soft glow
I want to spin you round nice and slow
Your hand in mine
The night’s our show

[Prechorus]
Claudia Camacho
Your name's a song
Claudia Camacho
Where you belong

[Chorus]
Ay Love bachata
Come sway with me
Ay Love bachata
Set your spirit free
Feel the rhythm
Feel the heat
Ay Love bachata
Hearts in the beat

[Verse 2]
The floor is ours
Stars start to cheer
Whispered steps
Your voice so near
One turn
One dip
Erase the fear

[Prechorus]
Claudia Camacho
Dance till we’re lost
Claudia Camacho
No matter the cost

[Chorus]
Ay Love bachata
Come sway with me
Ay Love bachata
Set your spirit free
Feel the rhythm
Feel the heat
Ay Love bachata
Hearts in the beat
